capabilities: Create goals and milestones and link tasks to them via tags
Manage tasks as Markdown notes with status, priority, dates, and time estimates
Organize tasks on a Notion-style Kanban board with drag-and-drop status changes
Track actual time spent per task with described time entries
Review time statistics by day, week, month, or year across goals, tags, and projects
extras: Full bilingual (English/Chinese) README with a link to external documentation. Requires the Bases core plugin to be enabled. The iOS app does not connect to the vault automatically; users must follow in-app setup instructions and verify with a test task. The task-capture workflow is designed for Chinese users.
intentEvidence: TaskNotes Time is based on the open-source TaskNotes project and adds its own product design and feature improvements.
motivation: The author built it to connect goals, tasks, and real time records so daily activity can be reviewed against long-term priorities.
problem: Ordinary to-do lists only show what is left to do; they do not show whether the time actually spent matches your goals and priorities.

relations.evidence: TaskNotes Time is based on the open-source TaskNotes project and adds its own product design

summary: Goal, task, and time management plugin that keeps every task as a Markdown note and tracks time spent against goals.
